title: Product Analyst

Identify high-volume or high-impact issues requiring deeper investigation and escalation. Monitor key performance indicators and communicate findings to stakeholders through clear visualizations and presentations. Support data-driven decision-making through meaningful analysis and recommendations. Operational Excellence Evaluate customer communication and service interactions through calls, chats, and emails to monitor policy adherence and service quality. Analyze operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce escalations, and shorten resolution times.
